notes.title: PositronX Patch version 0.9.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32123945/2e32d49189049b4a99a1081a95edcf23940486f6.png

Hello Positrons!

Let me start by thanking everyone for the fast and helpful feedback you have offered us since the last update! 

Here’s what’s been fixed in version 0.9.3:

 fixed hidden room infinite reward glitch - reward terminal now grants only one reward per hidden room
 fixed the interact prompt bug that would block a player progressing into the next room or from interacting with objects - the interact prompt will now show the correct key assigned to the command 


Happy robot hunting,
The Scorpius crew

notes.title: Hidden Levels, Weapon Pickups, Timed and Special Stage Rewards - PositronX 0.7.7 Update
notes.notes:
Version 0.7.7 is out now. Not too long overdue, 0.7.6 wasn't worthy of release as it was, so we took a little longer to make sure everything that has been added in is solid and fun.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/a6d835511a9ef65990e86a82233a9c6eb42d9d3a.jpg

Key points in this release are (a bit spoilery):
- Hidden Levels
- Weapon Pickups and Bonuses
- Timed Rewards
- Special Stage Rewards
- Player Permanent Bonuses 
Lots of other adjustments and fixes have made their way into this build, enjoy!

For a detailed change log please read https://steamcommunity.com/app/529970/discussions/3/2727382174645613411/

Additionally, we are working on Stage 3, new enemies and new music for the game.

notes.title: Tutorial, All maps redesigned, Zero G Fields, Redefine-able input for keyboard/controller - PositronX 0.7.5 Update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/c8215fc01e414282bb5e0a89e47861f7b6835cf8.jpg

We have skipped a version (from 0.7.3 to 0.7.5) because of the amount of changes we've done this month. Version 0.7.4. was somewhere in between and it didn't make sense to release it as a standalone version.

Keypoints
As part of our efforts in easing new users into playing the game we have implemented a basic tutorial which should address that for new players. Also we have redefine-able keyboard and controller input.
Our main bulk of work has been spent on improving on every map in the game, changed completely the graphical theme for the first stage and improved and updated part of the theme for stage 2 and redesigning all maps at the same time. There are more details, decals and coherency in color theme for maps in both stages. We also started on adding support for Spatial Anomalies, the first one being a Zero G Field. Plus, tons of adjustments and fixes to the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/64f78df218805f0d63bf54fe849b29b36b2871e5.jpg

All of our resources are going towards having Stage3 asap in the application, playable and fun.

Detailed Changed log For a detailed change log please follow this link: https://steamcommunity.com/app/529970/discussions/3/1727575977580490600/

notes.title: Streamlining fighting experience - PositronX 0.7.3 Update
notes.notes:
This update focuses on streamlining the fighting experience of PositronX. Enemies are easier to kill now but health and ammunition are scarce. Also Implant's cooldowns only update while in combat.
We had to postpone rebind keys/full controller support in UI for a later update.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/6309f7925fabb5a997fb42d6c6a5cf72c58a33aa.jpg

For a detailed change log please visit this link https://steamcommunity.com/app/529970/discussions/3/1693795812300339323/

notes.title: Game+, Local Leaderboards, Basic Controller support coming in 0.7.2 PositronX Update
notes.notes:
We just released out second update since Early Access Release two weeks ago and we've made some major advancements in features we wanted to support 'asap' when E.A. started as well as added new features people playing the game asked for.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32123945/6309f7925fabb5a997fb42d6c6a5cf72c58a33aa.jpg

Game+  Keep playing the game on higher difficulty levels with the same character
Local Leaderboards Measure how well they've played against previous best scores
Controller support Play with a controller (basic support, will complete in the next update)
No crosshair option For veterans and courageous people as well

There are a lot of other features and fixes that made their way through, please read this thread for more details https://steamcommunity.com/app/529970/discussions/3/2828702372997594397/
